newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU and U.S. agree customs cooperation deal.
newsitem.headline: EU and U.S. agree customs cooperation deal.

text.p: The European Union and United States have agreed a customs cooperation pact that officials hope will cut red tape surrounding bilateral trade, the European Commission said on Thursday.

The Commission -- the EU's executive -- said in statement that the aim of the agreement was to simplify customs procedures between the Europe and the U.S. as well as promote efforts to combat commercial fraud.
The agreement was one of the chief aims of the Transatlantic Agenda, the formal dialogue started last year between the EU and Washington to boost trade, political and educational exchanges.
A similar agreement was signed with South Korea in July and negotiations are also underway with Canadian authorities.
